source_snapshot.items: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and UPHY0 from first PG548
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC reads bus5 mux0x71, writes0x01 for port0 and refers to PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: No exact downstream reply, readback, timeout or restoration; generic artifacts only.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; invents physical probing/soldering despite supplied BMC commands.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Adds mux safety but retains unsupported Manual Only/photo interpretation.

old_problem: I2C-6/bus5 mapping, first-PG548 mux0x71 port0/UPHY0 endpoints,0x01 bit semantics, expected replies, exclusive ownership, sibling port2 health and exact restore are missing; prior reviews replace functional coverage with physical-only evidence.
disposition_reason: The specified BMC transaction is partially automatable, but ED-03 requires authoritative OEM topology/response data and ED-12 requires safe reversible state. It remains Pending/Requires Confirmation, not Manual Only, until PID mapping and restoration are approved.
decision_basis: Read row125/history2516 and retained port0/UPHY0 independently from row123 port2/UPHY1 and row126's separate topology conflict.
Preserved BMC, bus5, mux0x71,0x01, first PG548, UPHY0 and PID1114953.
Required endpoint replies, bit preservation, exclusive access, sibling port2 validation and exact original-byte restoration.
No force access, bus scan, mux write, BMC reset, physical probe or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: First PG548 mux0x71 port0 to UPHY0 functional path
test_case.purpose: Verify logical BMC I2C-6 reaches PID-defined UPHY0 endpoints through bus5 first-PG548 mux0x71 port0, while preserving the mux's UPHY1/other channels and restoring its exact original state.
required_package: PID1114953 first-PG548 mux0x71 port0/UPHY0 topology and response matrix
Proof logical I2C-6 maps to i2c-tools bus5
Mux owner/driver and exclusive raw-access window
Downstream reads, NACK/timeout rules, sibling health, original-state restore and BMC recovery
test_case.test_command: After approval, record BMC health, ownership and original0x71 byte; select port0 with the approved0x01 or masked equivalent; verify readback; perform only PID-defined UPHY0 reads; verify port2/UPHY1 and other channels remain healthy; restore exact original byte and recheck services.
test_case.expected_result: The signed UPHY0 endpoints respond within bounds through first-PG548 port0, unrelated channels and management services remain healthy, and mux/readback plus endpoint state return exactly to baseline after restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires proven mapping, approved bit semantics, expected downstream replies, sibling health and exact restore. Mux ACK alone, blind scan, NACK/timeout/arbitration loss, port2 impact or state drift fails; physical photos are not required absent separate decision.
safety_gate: Authoritative BMC/platform topology and independent recovery.
No force/raw access while mux0x71 is owned or busy.
Capture original byte and preserve unrelated enabled bits.
One bounded select/read sequence; abort and restore on bus or management degradation.
expected_evidence: Original mux byte,0x01 selection and readback interpretation
Port2/UPHY1 and other-channel health plus bus logs
Exact restoration/readback, services and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Restore the exact recorded0x71 byte, confirm UPHY0, UPHY1/port2 and BMC services. Use independent BMC recovery only for stuck bus and never leave port0 selected or retry automatically.
